title: Same or Not? Enhancing Visual Perception in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on the custom TWIN dataset and FGVQA benchmark to test if models rely on coarse-grained category-level semantics (like shared brand or color) rather than perceiving fine-grained, instance-level visual differences.

Reporting model accuracy on the external VLMBIAS benchmark to ensure that post-training models on fine-grained visual data does not negatively impact or exacerbate general language priors and multi-modal biases.
